Prickly pear supplements (made from *Opuntia* cactus pads/nopales or fruit) are ` [Highlight start] typically taken for blood sugar support, antioxidant intake, cholesterol management, and hangover relief [Highlight end] ` . However, human research on supplements is still limited, dosing isn't standardized, and potential side effects or medication interactions warrant caution.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF12a666WIgh2Hs1YoauIBAGDkQfKc4t3gBhbxOwKGHuOa4fG2dCCxCtHseWb40oPGoL2FGNwZFFvblK9jKKtYXmbKMC0SjznO3gL7PF2mG0NCN-r8whJ3NYchsNzB-n0SfMCATBye9pDpXJKAfwNJ2dj1ID2lDjZngL2UIPtv6kXsSgMlysVG3A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpwEBxCJF1_QqjmjhBL2xqOZf132G8D6qqgh5lE4nxmqAq61DXpoEFjV44kMZBG1pwvGK1kE5oyU2XI1R6Zk8qOHWElfjfNweJOyBqQncAWTf5nm9F3-EYsSah9aaxlTtHhC0AlaJEIY_SOTU2G8tLoV5qYjU8YxoTiI42M6ohGdmB6BfqUM_RQPb_ZTpsCF6W-CA1C_XzMcBYxkVOPyAskHuNc8M6WBV8w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXX0lp88JnsrwCUjm8KRQ9JWVVcXsIJ1zIl2OKtyQJ5m-jZXPnFh7xiMShwY9Ns0pfclcSLsf19HDMPGLHkySMBh16IzHm0aOYJDcQxrcqR9TyRUgjbkRK-z7ZGxqw751EMNzH8w_iTjwbB3Cc6sknSwQ)

### Potential Benefits & Evidence

- **Blood sugar support:** Early evidence suggests cactus pad/stem supplements may help lower blood sugar levels in people with type 2 diabetes.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpwEBxCJF1_QqjmjhBL2xqOZf132G8D6qqgh5lE4nxmqAq61DXpoEFjV44kMZBG1pwvGK1kE5oyU2XI1R6Zk8qOHWElfjfNweJOyBqQncAWTf5nm9F3-EYsSah9aaxlTtHhC0AlaJEIY_SOTU2G8tLoV5qYjU8YxoTiI42M6ohGdmB6BfqUM_RQPb_ZTpsCF6W-CA1C_XzMcBYxkVOPyAskHuNc8M6WBV8w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF12a666WIgh2Hs1YoauIBAGDkQfKc4t3gBhbxOwKGHuOa4fG2dCCxCtHseWb40oPGoL2FGNwZFFvblK9jKKtYXmbKMC0SjznO3gL7PF2mG0NCN-r8whJ3NYchsNzB-n0SfMCATBye9pDpXJKAfwNJ2dj1ID2lDjZngL2UIPtv6kXsSgMlysVG3A)
- **Hangover symptoms:** Some research indicates prickly pear extract may ease certain hangover symptoms—such as nausea and dry mouth—likely due to anti-inflammatory effects.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpwEBxCJF1_QqjmjhBL2xqOZf132G8D6qqgh5lE4nxmqAq61DXpoEFjV44kMZBG1pwvGK1kE5oyU2XI1R6Zk8qOHWElfjfNweJOyBqQncAWTf5nm9F3-EYsSah9aaxlTtHhC0AlaJEIY_SOTU2G8tLoV5qYjU8YxoTiI42M6ohGdmB6BfqUM_RQPb_ZTpsCF6W-CA1C_XzMcBYxkVOPyAskHuNc8M6WBV8w)
- **Antioxidants & heart health:** Prickly pear contains fiber, antioxidants, betalains, and carotenoids, and is studied for supporting cholesterol and reducing inflammation, though more clinical data is needed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXX0lp88JnsrwCUjm8KRQ9JWVVcXsIJ1zIl2OKtyQJ5m-jZXPnFh7xiMShwY9Ns0pfclcSLsf19HDMPGLHkySMBh16IzHm0aOYJDcQxrcqR9TyRUgjbkRK-z7ZGxqw751EMNzH8w_iTjwbB3Cc6sknSwQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpwEBxCJF1_QqjmjhBL2xqOZf132G8D6qqgh5lE4nxmqAq61DXpoEFjV44kMZBG1pwvGK1kE5oyU2XI1R6Zk8qOHWElfjfNweJOyBqQncAWTf5nm9F3-EYsSah9aaxlTtHhC0AlaJEIY_SOTU2G8tLoV5qYjU8YxoTiI42M6ohGdmB6BfqUM_RQPb_ZTpsCF6W-CA1C_XzMcBYxkVOPyAskHuNc8M6WBV8w)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXSXgsIgmJrAj8qjrm76KAga_nSXhcGbCwm2CFT7G1SlpX_kXM-8kmbrPOmMbjsG8NiB10F5lADdsYsNNp_RUWiivXWshIMz_MAaVixkGHLZehjyQs3LZUZE6Bt-kDDxxoH6soEfOQwBuAM4s)

### Common Forms & Examples

- **Capsules & tablets:** Often made from dried nopal cactus pads/cladodes, such as Carlyle Prickly Pear capsules or Solaray Nopal Prickly Pear Cactus VegCaps.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXX8JR7V_dl4BPEDKFhg9uPmJm7SFLLbXZs6Sg22VgxjL-x8D8Et4OnscUuiUezcyoKTiYf4fW3AnlsolEKBTL7IkrOoC4P-Bf7v-enB891379oqUudngD1uokX0iOgLOH7HFrRAT26onQabpy3)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF16EzaYa9DdApKY-xSvIHap3lWom5-tqLIJzxPxaa3d7eAQLu7gwMZTbqYsdi3cpdtrUckJrwQDAnr_TCI1lZK8BvWTUzI5nZUcOQFpEJNiK5NYe6J_g3QPczIq1GjKoo50QBG5NCnk2Vtv5iaczwZgdrcyrpvXDGU6OcZ_lNOtTo5GP-tlJUngGzrvhpzGVFW-yY)
- **Liquid drops & concentrates:** Fruit-based concentrates and extracts, such as Prickly Pear Drops with Vitamin B12 or [Arizona Cactus Ranch](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHEIkXXlBCnOJ17WJ_U0ZwJQEYny9_cC70RHsFDJLBk0XH4c1kyWJs8c9mISV9koX6Er1bK11d-bY1VIXIqJ3733vvtk1RxneTpk_vyRYNwaCq6DdKbv1ZWBg) prickly pear concentrates.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF17QtOeKyM0dz_EH145km-9PWGk_Mf9yd_IeSsh1PK-gnNxKBUCvf69q6pg5Mm1DdT6XcQlbcQ-4ddEnjOw6xp_hx89k-HIHi93hLFddwruUd9AD0jkoBWqdVXgP0z4i_8YJmuHyb2GCwaLJ1itCBA8tZ1eo3y834Q0OSn7kZGhH2p3JBWtONbg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHEIkXXlBCnOJ17WJ_U0ZwJQEYny9_cC70RHsFDJLBk0XH4c1kyWJs8c9mISV9koX6Er1bK11d-bY1VIXIqJ3733vvtk1RxneTpk_vyRYNwaCq6DdKbv1ZWBg)

### Side Effects & Precautions

- **Digestive issues:** Can cause diarrhea, bloating, nausea, stomach fullness, or more frequent bowel movements—especially if you take too much or start too quickly.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpwEBxCJF1_QqjmjhBL2xqOZf132G8D6qqgh5lE4nxmqAq61DXpoEFjV44kMZBG1pwvGK1kE5oyU2XI1R6Zk8qOHWElfjfNweJOyBqQncAWTf5nm9F3-EYsSah9aaxlTtHhC0AlaJEIY_SOTU2G8tLoV5qYjU8YxoTiI42M6ohGdmB6BfqUM_RQPb_ZTpsCF6W-CA1C_XzMcBYxkVOPyAskHuNc8M6WBV8w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXX0lp88JnsrwCUjm8KRQ9JWVVcXsIJ1zIl2OKtyQJ5m-jZXPnFh7xiMShwY9Ns0pfclcSLsf19HDMPGLHkySMBh16IzHm0aOYJDcQxrcqR9TyRUgjbkRK-z7ZGxqw751EMNzH8w_iTjwbB3Cc6sknSwQ)
- **Drug & medical interactions:** May interact with diabetes medications (risking low blood sugar), is generally advised to stop before surgery, and lacks established safety data for pregnancy, breastfeeding, and children.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF12a666WIgh2Hs1YoauIBAGDkQfKc4t3gBhbxOwKGHuOa4fG2dCCxCtHseWb40oPGoL2FGNwZFFvblK9jKKtYXmbKMC0SjznO3gL7PF2mG0NCN-r8whJ3NYchsNzB-n0SfMCATBye9pDpXJKAfwNJ2dj1ID2lDjZngL2UIPtv6kXsSgMlysVG3A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXX0lp88JnsrwCUjm8KRQ9JWVVcXsIJ1zIl2OKtyQJ5m-jZXPnFh7xiMShwY9Ns0pfclcSLsf19HDMPGLHkySMBh16IzHm0aOYJDcQxrcqR9TyRUgjbkRK-z7ZGxqw751EMNzH8w_iTjwbB3Cc6sknSwQ)
